Attached: 1 image

Chessnado playtest tomorrow, Sunday 6pm EDT (22:00 UTC)!

A chess RTS browser game: four armies share one board, unlimited* players, no turns. Captured pieces come back as reinforcements, last king standing wins. Expect chaos.

Play now, no install, no signup: https://chessnado.app
Voice chat on Discord, invite on the site.

*well, 5,000+ in load tests. Bots on one box aren't real connections, which is why I need you.
